inlines.v: DEEM, verb transitive 1. To think; to judge; to be of opinion; to conclude on consideration; as, he deems it prudent to be silent. For never can I deem him less than god. The shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country. Acts 27:27. 2. To estimate. DEEM, noun Opinion; judgment; surmise.
